data.fund_type: An open-ended scheme replicating/tracking Nifty Midcap 150 Total Return Index
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the scheme is to invest in stocks comprising the Nifty Midcap 150 Index in the same proportions as in the index to achieve returns equivalent to the Total Return Index of Nifty Midcap 150 Index (subject to tracking error).There can be no assurance or guarantee that the investment objective of the Scheme would be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: Equities and equity related securities covered by Nifty Midcap 150 Index TRI - 95 to 100% Debt and Money Market Instruments, cash and cash equivalents - 0 to 5%
